question: Does the persistence repair, now shipped in the 0.14.0 engine rather than an in-process subclass, survive six fresh seed-determined worlds against a pre-repair denominator control?

prior.defect: D3-PERSISTENCE-2 measured the in-process arm at 0.13.0; it did not run the shipped 0.14.0 engine.
prior.reading: The repair was promoted at 0.14.0 under the dated owner decision. This block reruns the same criteria on fresh seeds with the shipped engine as treatment and a benchmark-only pre-repair denominator ablation as control.

scope.instrument: benchmarks/long_delay_capability.py -- online next-cycle recall@5, k = 5, for the early-cost criterion
scope.burst_excluded: burst_L1 is excluded. Q052 amendment A2 classified its late collapse DIFFERENT_SUPPORT_COLLAPSE, so it is not a second instance of this mechanism and may not be pooled.
scope.why_this_pair: L3 is the adopted G1 witness; L1 is the campaign stimulus. A repair must satisfy both or it has not repaired the thing the campaign is gated on.
scope.seed_axis: the design's triangle order is shuffled by the seed before lattice_stream, and the resulting stream is rotated by seed modulo its length; the multiset and local triangle structure are fixed, the schedule is seed-determined

mechanism.name: matched source-frequency decay on the shipped engine
mechanism.changes: The treatment is the shipped 0.14.0 SleepService, including the per-cycle decayed source-frequency denominator D = 0.95 * D_previous + delta. The control is a benchmark-only subclass that returns the raw tag frequencies, reproducing the pre-promotion denominator. No other layer or constant changes.

parameter.order: the decayed counter is updated once per cycle, before _build_predictions

preserves: the admission count and every cap
the retention policy and which structures compete
does_not: change the admission floor or the candidate set
add a budget, a reserved pool or a second mechanism
regenerate or resurrect a belief that formation no longer proposes
mechanism.prediction: If the promotion preserved the measured mechanism, the shipped engine should keep L1 alive through 3,000 cycles on the fresh seed-varying worlds while the legacy raw-denominator control still dies before cycle 60.
mechanism.risk: The legacy control could fail to reproduce the pre-promotion death; G1 would then void the block rather than license a persistence claim.
mechanism.implementation: organica/sleep.py at 0.14.0; the control is benchmark-only

control.rule: the pre-repair raw source-frequency denominator, otherwise the shipped 0.14.0 engine

treatment.rule: the shipped 0.14.0 engine, including the matched source-frequency denominator

witness.reads: the whole per-cycle theory trace, plus the NO_DREAMS and NO_QUESTIONS negative controls

preflight.reads: the first cycle with zero theories after a positive one; the treatment runs the full horizon

design.cells_arithmetic: 2 stages x 2 arms x 6 seeds = 24 cells
design.pairing: both arms of a seed run on the same seed-determined world and stimulus; only the service class differs
design.world_variation: random.Random(seed).shuffle(triangles) before lattice_stream, then rotate the stream by seed modulo its length; both arms of a seed receive the same shuffled and rotated stream. Six seeds produce six distinct 216-event streams per design; the triangle multiset and local triangle structure are unchanged.
design.freshness: the first contiguous seven-integer window at or above 20611201 that appears in no artifact, harness, test, document or journal; checked before this record was written

W1_witness.quantity: the treatment's theory cycles and peak on the L3 witness over 40 cycles
W1_witness.rule: at least 39 of 40 theory cycles and a peak of at least 6, on at least 5 of 6 seeds, with both negative controls at zero across the trace
W1_witness.bar_provenance: the adopted witness's measured baseline in docs/tier1_preflight.json, not calibrated on the treatment
W1_witness.on_failure: WITNESS BROKEN: the repair cannot be adopted even if it keeps L1 alive, because it breaks the gate the campaign is verified on

P1_persistence.quantity: the treatment's theory count in the last 100 cycles of the L1 horizon
P1_persistence.rule: no first zero through cycle 3000 and a theory count above zero in every one of the last 100 cycles, on at least 5 of 6 seeds
P1_persistence.bar: 5 of 6 seeds alive at the horizon
P1_persistence.bar_provenance: 3000 is the campaign's own horizon from D2. The 5/6 bar is declared, not calibrated: the campaign requires one live colony, and a majority guards against a single-seed fluke without demanding every seed.
P1_persistence.on_failure: NO REPAIR: the arm still dies before the campaign horizon, so the campaign stays not measurable as designed

C1_early_cost.quantity: next-cycle recall@5 over cycles 5-36, median per-seed gap (treatment minus control)
C1_early_cost.rule: median gap at or above the early-cost bound
C1_early_cost.bar_provenance: Q051's early equivalence margin, carried unchanged; a larger early loss prices the trade and blocks adoption

gates.G1_baseline_death: the control must record a first zero after a positive cycle at or before cycle 60 on every seed; if the control survives, there is no death to repair and the block is void
gates.G2_manipulation_live: both arms must record decay 0.95 and death threshold 0.15; the treatment must record frequency_decay 0.95 and a non-zero denominator update in every cycle; a treatment that differs on the decay constant or never updates the denominator is void
gates.G3_noop_control: the control's structure fingerprint must equal the shipped engine's fingerprint recorded in the run artifact
gates.G4_determinism: the control re-run on the first seed must reproduce its recorded fingerprint
gates.G5_seed_block: the cells must be exactly the frozen 24, with both stages and both arms of every seed and no cell outside the block
gates.G6_denominator: every witness cell must report at least one early prediction, and every preflight cell must report at least one early prediction; a cell with none is not measurable and the block is void
gates.G7_negative_controls: NO_DREAMS must record zero dreams and NO_QUESTIONS zero questions in every witness cycle
gates.void_rule: a failed gate voids the block and no criterion is read
gates.G8_seed_axis_live: the preflight treatment must produce at least two distinct trajectory signatures across the six seeds; if all six are identical, the block is VOID because the seed axis did not vary the measured trajectory

decision_table.reading: the block is unrun; the failed gate names what did not happen, and no criterion is read
the repair damages the L3 witness, so it cannot be adopted for the campaign even if L1 stays alive; the failure is a property of the repair, not of the witness

decision_table.condition: gates pass; W1 passes; P1 fails
decision_table.reading: the arm still dies before the campaign horizon; persistence is not restored, and the campaign remains not measurable as designed

decision_table.condition: gates pass; W1 passes; P1 passes; C1 fails
decision_table.reading: the arm survives to the horizon but loses early ranking beyond the equivalence margin; the trade is priced and nothing is adopted

decision_table.condition: gates pass; W1 passes; P1 passes; C1 passes
decision_table.reading: the arm survives to the campaign horizon with the witness intact and no early cost beyond the margin; adoption is still an owner decision and is not implied by the label

adoption.rule: The repair is already promoted at 0.14.0. A pass is a replication of the shipped engine and creates no new adoption; a failure opens a correction and does not re-open the historical D3 results.
not_authorised: changing the engine from this replication
re-scoring a criterion after the block runs
pooling burst_L1 cells into this block
launching the Tier-1 campaign on the strength of this block alone
adoption.withdrawal: A W1 failure withdraws the replication claim: the promoted engine does not preserve the witness. A P1 failure records NO REPAIR for this replication. Withdrawal is not deletion: the block stays in the record, and a different mechanism needs its own preregistration.

stop_condition: one mechanism, one protocol, one replication block of 24 cells. The record may be fixed if it is found wrong; it may not grow into a second mechanism, endpoint or block.
not_evidence: This is a fresh-seed replication of the promoted engine against a pre-repair control. A pass does not establish a new adoption or a transfer claim; it records whether the promoted behavior survives this seed-varying block.
